content.text: {"notes":["Requested readouts are at absolute time t=1.0 s in the right-handed world frame, where x is forward, y is left, and z is up.","Load position is a world-frame vector in metres; swing_angle is an unwrapped angle in radians; angular_velocity is in radians per second.","The scheduled support intervention runs on [0.416, 0.616) s: +0.2706981783 m/s² for 0.1 s, then the same magnitude with negative sign for 0.1 s, followed by stationary support.","boundary_crossed indicates whether the load COM crosses x=0.1 m after the observation cutoff, using 0.005 m hysteresis." ]}
